description: This file defines a package-private, non-thread-safe Java class 'JsonFieldSelectorTrie' which represents a trie data structure for efficiently traversing JSON field selectors as a prefix tree. It provides methods to create the trie from JSON pointers, add paths, check for children, and retrieve child nodes. The trie is used to facilitate traversal of JSON objects based on field selectors without merging sub-objects.

classes.name: JsonFieldSelectorTrie
classes.description: A package-private trie data structure for representing JSON field selectors as a prefix tree to facilitate traversal.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a Trie from an iterable collection of JsonPointers, initializing the structure to represent the collection as a prefix tree.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a JsonPointer path to the trie, ensuring the path exists within the structure.

methods.name: addJsonKeyIterator
methods.description: Private helper method that adds a path to the trie based on an iterator of JsonKeys, allowing efficient incremental addition.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trie has any child nodes.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of keys representing the immediate children of this node.

methods.name: descend
methods.description: Retrieves the child node associated with a given JsonKey, returning an empty trie if none exists.
